## Cross-cutting invariants
Never publish a total (§32, SIG-METRIC-008/009/010) — named denominators only, pinned THREE ways
(Python choke point `assert_coverage_row_has_named_denominator`, the DB `coverage_metric_named_denominator`
CHECK, the always-refusing capture-recapture/multi-list estimators); absence is a visible gap, not a
guess (`not_researched`, distinguished from `searched_not_found`); append-only (INSERT ON CONFLICT DO
NOTHING; no UPDATE/DELETE); every inference labelled (`searched_by`/`search_method`/`named_denominator`);
Part VIII (tier-0-only reads). Reuse-not-reimplement (SIG-ENG-035): `inference.coverage` (`CoverageRecord`),
`inference.denominators` (`PublishedAggregate`, `provenance_completeness`), `inference.completeness`
(`CompletenessMethod`, `assert_no_population_total`) are CONSUMED.

## Evidence report
Honest §32 coverage is materialized + proven over real PG18+PostGIS: a new append-only, idempotent (+0)
coverage write path (`coverage_materialize` sqitch change + `inference materialize-coverage`) that runs the
§32 coverage inference over the real (resolved) spine and writes durable `coverage_record` rows — counted
quantities with NAMED denominators (§32.2/32.3 provenance completeness), per-predicate reconciliation
ratios (§32.5), and the honest negative space (§32.1 `not_researched`, distinguished from
`searched_not_found`) — each carrying its denominator, and NEVER a total or a population estimate. The
no-total invariant is a hard, TEST-PINNED contract enforced THREE ways: a Python choke point
(`assert_coverage_row_has_named_denominator`, which re-validates every metric row as a `CompletenessStatement`
and refuses a reality denominator), a DB CHECK (`coverage_metric_named_denominator`, so a population total
cannot be inserted even by hand), and the always-refusing capture-recapture / multi-list estimators
(SIG-METRIC-008/008a). The §32 shapes (`inference.coverage`/`denominators`/`completeness`) are CONSUMED,
not re-implemented (SIG-ENG-035); `read_materialized_coverage` is the real coverage dataset the P28.5
surface refresh consumes. The P28.1 resolution eval (holdout P/R/F1, κ=0.714, floor 0.980, B-cubed
F1=0.976) is surfaced honestly on the public methodology page (SIG measuring its own method, §32.5/
SIG-METRIC-008b) with the PROVISIONAL disclosure (D-R6.1-EVAL) preserved verbatim — a static, zero-JS
addition, not the P28.5 surface refresh. Measured survey recall (SIG-METRIC-008b) is deliberately NOT
emitted: it requires a pre-registered blind field survey with locations that the spine does not contain,
and fabricating one would be synthetic certainty (an honest omission, not a gap). `make check` exit 0
(3688 passed), `make test-db` 168 passed, `npm --prefix web run check` exit 0 (244 e2e; export-mode build
53 pages). The hosted-over-`sig-pg` materialization is honestly deferred (D-R6.4-COVERAGE, BL-057) with the
exact re-run command — no fabricated hosted number. No new ADR (ADR-099 covers the materialize-at-scale
posture; the §32 semantics are consumed, not newly decided).
